name: Vilemon
main_effect:
[When Moving] [When Digivolving] Trash 1 card in your hand. Then, your opponent may trash 1 card in their hand. If your opponent didn't trash with this effect, trash the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.
[All Turns] While your opponent has 10 or more cards in their trash, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and +2000 DP.
source_effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Trash the top card of both players' decks.
